[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained the differences between "Atomic Habits" and "Essentialism".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "Atomic Habits" focuses on small, incremental changes in behavior and building good habits.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "Essentialism" focuses on prioritizing what is truly important and eliminating non-essential tasks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended starting with "Atomic Habits" for practical, step-by-step guidance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested "Essentialism" if the user feels overwhelmed or unsure about priorities.
